results.title: Vexev Raises $6M to Scale Autonomous Robotic Vascular Ultrasound￼
results.description: What You Should Know Australian medical robotics and computational imaging startup Vexev raised $6M in new funding, bringing its total capital raised to date to $19M. The capital will support FDA 510(k) regulatory clearance, domestic manufacturing scale-up, and commercial launch in the United States for VxWave, its autonomous robotic tomographic ultrasound platform.
